items.title: Man’s Body Found Stuffed in Sack, Dumped in Dwarka Drain
items.desc: Body of a 25-year-old man found stuffed in a sack and dumped in a Dwarka drain in Delhi; police probe murder, check CCTV and missing-person reports.

items.title: Liquor bottle inside Delhi Police PCR van: Head constable suspended, DTC driver attached to Lines
items.desc: Delhi Police suspended a head constable after a video showed a liquor bottle inside a PCR van; a DTC driver was identified and attached to Lines.

items.title: Russian Strikes Pound Kyiv Region As Ukrainian Children Head Back To School
items.desc: Russian air strikes pounded the Kyiv region, killing and injuring local residents as children across Ukraine headed to school for their first day of classes on September 1.

items.title: Another Call of Duty title joins Xbox Game Pass as Cyberpunk 2077 leaves it for September's first wave of games coming a
items.desc: Microsoft has revealed the first batch of games coming and leaving Xbox Game Pass in September 2026; the biggest highlights include Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, RuneScape Dragonwilds, and Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage.

items.title: 25-year-old stabbed to death by friend
items.desc: Central Delhi murder: 25-year-old Shivam Mathur stabbed to death by friend after dispute at Dhobi Ghat; accused Shivam Chauhan arrested, knife seized.

items.title: Rape case filed after 3-yr-old girl found near railway tracks in Gidderbaha
items.desc: GRP Abohar registers rape case after 3.5-year-old girl found injured near railway tracks in Gidderbaha; child hospitalized, suspect unidentified.

items.title: Hookah hideout busted: Two held for running bar from rented house
items.desc: Bengaluru police raided a Kenchanapura house turned into an illegal hookah bar, arresting two and seizing hookahs, supplies and Rs 450.

items.title: Mahuadanr’s aromatic Jeera Phool rice finds market in Gurgaon
items.desc: Latehar district dispatches 6.70 MT of Jeera Phool aromatic rice to Gurgaon, backed by JSLPS support and a ₹1 crore processing plant, says DC Sandip Kumar.

items.title: HC slams cops over Dhantoli parking woes, says temp measures in vain
items.desc: Bombay High Court’s Nagpur bench slams traffic police over Dhantoli parking chaos, urges effective implementation of July 2024 traffic notification.

items.title: 140 streetlights out, engineer suspended after minister’s inspection
items.desc: Bengaluru suspends executive engineer HV Ramesh after minister finds 140 of 222 streetlights non-functional on Hudson Circle–Chalukya Circle stretch.

items.title: Pedestrians Left To Risk Their Lives As City Lacks Safe Walking Spaces
items.desc: Nagpur pedestrians risk lives as encroached footpaths, illegal parking and lack of walking tracks force residents onto busy roads; calls grow for safe spaces.

items.title: NMC’s 1,282-pothole Count Raises Questions As 2,772km Of TAR Roads Await Repairs Ahead Of Ganeshotsav
items.desc: Nagpur NMC reports 1,282 potholes on 2,772km tar roads, faces survey methodology questions; five teams deployed for Ganeshotsav route repairs.

items.title: DAV PG College students protest centralised mgmt, lock college gates
items.desc: DAV PG College Dehradun students locked gates and blocked roads, demanding written assurance for local decision-making authority and clarity on hostel land.

items.title: ‘No business to defer order’: HC pulls up trial court for withholding decision despite SC mandate
items.desc: Uttarakhand HC raps Haridwar trial court for deferring decision on release of Rs 31.2 crore frozen funds, says SC order must be complied with; directs order in 2 weeks.

items.title: Op-Ed: It's Time to Bring Back the Draft
items.desc: A University of Pennsylvania professor is arguing that if Americans want a louder debate over the war in Iran, they should start by putting their own kids at risk of fighting it. In an essay at the Hill , historian Jonathan Zimmerman contends the near-absence…

items.title: Man detained at Kurnool industrial unit over alleged terror links
items.desc: Suspected terrorist Noor Mohammad detained at Shiva Tech factory in Kurnool after IB inputs alleged links and phone contact with extremist operatives; probed further.

items.title: 3 people stranded in Kalanuthala stream rescued
items.desc: Three people stranded after a Bolero was swept into Kalanuthala stream in Peddaraveedu were rescued overnight by police, fire staff and officials.

items.title: UPES student among 2 killed after SUV swept away in Dehradun rain
items.desc: UPES student and woman killed after SUV swept away by heavy rains and flash flooding in Dehradun’s Premnagar; SDRF rescues survivor, roads blocked.

items.title: GVMC chief reviews town planning, TDR cases
items.desc: GVMC commissioner Ketan Garg urges speedy disposal of pending TDR cases, stricter action on unauthorised buildings, and removal of road and footpath encroachments.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass September 2026 Wave 1 Lineup Announced
items.desc: Microsoft has announced the Xbox Game Pass September 2027 Wave 1 lineup, and it includes a Call of Duty blockbuster.
